blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods adapt large models by introducing a small number of trainable parameters. However, we find that these parameters still contain redundancy and can be further compressed while maintaining strong task performance. To this end, we propose a novel hierarchical low-rank reparameterization method. Its core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of PEFT methods into an approximately square matrix and then express it via a low-rank decomposition, which can be applied recursively. This forms a multi-level structure with factors compressed level by level, drastically reducing the number of trainable parameters. In our experiments, we combine this reparameterization with LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA. We evaluate commonsense reasoning on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, with additional GSM8K math reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B. Under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, our method combined with LoRA or DoRA achieves better performance. Furthermore,when the parameter count of the original methods is compressed by approximately an order of magnitude, our method can still maintain competitive task performance and even surpass the corresponding baselines in average accuracy across the eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 参数高效微调(PEFT)方法通过引入少量可受训练参数来适应大型模型. 然而,我们发现这些参数仍然含有冗余性,可以在保持强任务性能的同时被进一步压缩. 为此,我们提出了一种新的分级低级再平衡方法. 其核心理念是将PEFT方法的可训练参数重组为大约平方矩阵,再通过低等分解来表达,可递归应用. 这形成了多层次结构,因子按级别压缩,大大减少了可受训练参数的数量. 在我们的实验中,我们把这种再参数化与LORA,DORA,MOSA,以及RASA结合起来. 我们评价LLaMA-31-8B和Quen2.5-7B的常识推理,同时对LLaMA-31-8B进行额外的GSM8K数学推理实验. 根据可比的可训练参数预算,我们的方法与LORA或DORA相结合,取得了更好的业绩。 此外,当原始方法的参数数被压缩大约一个数量级时,我们的方法仍然能够保持具有竞争力的任务性能,甚至能够在8个常识推理基准的平均准确性上超过相应的基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large-scale pretrained models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks, but adapting these models to downstream applications remains challenging due to their enormous parameter scale [ 1 ] .
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) addresses this challenge by freezing the pretrained backbone and introducing a small number of trainable parameters [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] .
Existing PEFT methods have substantially reduced the cost of model adaptation [ 6 , 7 ] , but the introduced trainable parameters may still contain internal redundancy that has not been fully explored.
blocks.zh:
大规模预训模型在一系列广泛任务中表现出显著的能力,但由于这些模型的参数尺度巨大[1],使其适应下游应用仍然具有挑战性.
参数效率微调(PEFT)通过冻结预训骨干和引入少量可训练参数[2,3,4,5]来解决这一挑战.
现有的PEFT方法大大降低了模型改造的成本[6,7],但引入的可训练参数可能仍然含有尚未充分探索的内部冗余.

blocks.en:
Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become one of the most widely adopted PEFT methods due to its simplicity and effectiveness [ 5 ] . LoRA represents weight updates using a low-rank parameterization, in which only additional trainable parameters are optimized while the pretrained weights remain frozen. Many LoRA variants have been proposed to improve parameter efficiency, optimization, initialization, and adaptation capacity [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] .
For example, AdaLoRA [ 8 ] improves rank allocation, PiSSA [ 10 ] and EVA [ 13 ] construct more informative initializations, while DoRA [ 11 ] and MoRA [ 12 ] explore alternative update formulations.
These methods mainly optimize the design of specific PEFT mechanisms rather than reducing redundancy within the generated trainable parameters themselves.
blocks.zh:
Low-Rank 适应(LORA)因其简洁性和有效性而成为最广泛采用的PEFT方法之一[5]. LORA代表重量更新,使用低级参数化,其中在预训重量保持冻结的同时,只能优化额外的可训练参数. 提出了许多LORA变体,以提高参数效率、优化、初始化和适应能力[8、9、10、11、12]。
例如,AdaLora[8]改进了军衔分配,PISSA[10]和EVA[13]构建了更加翔实的初始化,而DORA[11]和MORA[12]则探索了替代更新配方.
这些方法主要是优化特定PEFT机制的设计,而不是减少生成的可训练参数本身内的冗余.

blocks.en:
Another line of research investigates compact and structured parameterizations for PEFT.
Methods such as VeRA [ 14 ] , NOLA [ 15 ] , LoRA-XS [ 16 ] , SVFit [ 17 ] , and NoRA [ 18 ] reduce trainable parameters through fixed bases, structured subspaces, compact cores, or nested representations.
Tensorized and sharing-based methods further explore alternative parameter structures through decomposition or parameter sharing [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] .
These existing approaches focus on introducing method-specific structures.
blocks.zh:
另一行研究调查了PEFT的紧凑和结构化参数化.
VERA [14],NOLA [15],LORA-XS [16],SVFit [17],NoRA [18] 等方法通过固定基地,结构化的子空间,紧凑的核心或嵌入式的表示减少可训练参数.
以十进制和共享为基础的方法通过分解或参数共享进一步探索替代参数结构[19,20,21,22,23,24].
这些现行办法的重点是采用特定方法的结构。

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose a novel general framework for compressing PEFT parameters via hierarchical low-rank reparameterization, called HiLoRR .
The core idea is to reorganize the trainable parameters of existing PEFT methods
into approximately square matrices and represent them using low-rank decomposition.
This reorganization-decomposition operation can be applied recursively to the resulting factors, forming a hierarchical structure where parameters are compressed level by level.
Unlike methods designed for a specific PEFT formulation, HiLoRR provides a general reparameterization framework that can be integrated with various adaptation methods, such as LoRA [ 5 ] , DoRA [ 11 ] , MoSA [ 23 ] , and RaSA [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出了通过等级低级的重新参数压缩PEFT参数的新式总框架,称为HiLORR.
核心思想是重组现有PEFT方法的可训练参数.

这种重组-分解操作可以递归到由此产生的因素上,形成一个分级结构,其中的参数按级别压缩.
与针对特定PEFT配方设计的方法不同,HiLORR提供了可与各种适应方法结合的通用的校正框架,如LORA[5],DORA[11],MOSA[23],RaSA[24].

blocks.en:
We evaluate PEFT methods enhanced with HiLoRR on LLaMA-3.1-8B [ 25 ] and Qwen2.5-7B [ 26 ] on commonsense reasoning benchmarks, with additional GSM8K mathematical reasoning experiments on LLaMA-3.1-8B.
Furthermore, the compressed variants reduce trainable parameters by approximately an order of magnitude while achieving higher average accuracy across the eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks than the corresponding high-parameter baselines (Table 1 ).
Experiments with MoSA and RaSA further demonstrate that HiLoRR can substantially reduce trainable parameters while maintaining performance close to the original methods (Table 3 ).

此外,压缩的变体将可训练参数减少大约一个数量级,同时实现8个常识推理基准的平均准确度高于相应的高参数基线(表1)。
与MOSA和RaSA的实验进一步证明,HILORR可以大幅度降低可训练参数,同时保持性能接近原始方法(表3).

blocks.en:
The contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We introduce HiLoRR, a general hierarchical low-rank reparameterization framework for compressing trainable parameters generated by existing PEFT methods and supporting recursive application. • We demonstrate that HiLoRR can be applied to multiple PEFT formulations, including LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA, without requiring method-specific redesign.
Experiments show improved overall performance under comparable trainable-parameter budgets, as well as substantial parameter reductions with competitive performance across the evaluated PEFT methods.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and LoRA. PEFT has become an effective paradigm for adapting large pretrained models by updating only a small subset of parameters while keeping the backbone frozen. Early PEFT
approaches mainly introduced additional trainable modules or optimized
input representations, including adapter modules, prompt tuning, and
prefix tuning [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
Among these approaches, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 5 ] has become one of the most widely adopted methods due to its simplicity and strong empirical performance.
LoRA represents the weight update as a low-rank decomposition, which is optimized while freezing the pretrained weights.
This formulation substantially reduces trainable parameters while maintaining competitive
performance.
Under the LoRA formulation, the adaptation rank simultaneously determines the trainable parameter budget and the rank upper bound of the update matrix.
Therefore, reducing the parameter budget by decreasing the rank also restricts the adaptation space.

blocks.en:
LoRA Variants. Following the success of LoRA, numerous variants have been proposed to
improve its parameter efficiency, optimization behavior, and adaptation
capacity. Rank-adaptive methods, such as AdaLoRA [ 8 ] and DyLoRA [ 27 ] , dynamically
adjust effective ranks or parameter budgets to better utilize limited
trainable parameters. Optimization-oriented approaches, including LoRA+ [ 9 ] and rsLoRA [ 28 ] , improve
the training dynamics of LoRA factors through asymmetric learning rates
and improved scaling strategies.
Other methods focus on initialization and update capacity. PiSSA [ 10 ] , EVA [ 13 ] ,
and LoRA-GA [ 29 ] exploit pretrained weights, activation statistics, or
gradient information to construct more informative initializations.
DoRA [ 11 ] decomposes weights into magnitude and direction components and uses LoRA for directional updates.
ReLoRA [ 30 ] periodically merges and reinitializes low-rank updates, whereas
MoRA [ 12 ] uses a square trainable matrix with non-parametric operators to construct higher-rank updates.
These methods mainly improve how LoRA ranks are allocated, how its factors are optimized or initialized, or how the resulting updates are constructed.
Different from them, we focus on recursively using the low-rank parameterization to reorganize their trainable parameters.

blocks.en:
Compact and Structured Parameterizations. A complementary line of research focuses on reducing task-specific parameters through compact representations and structured reparameterization.
VeRA [ 14 ] shares frozen random matrices across layers and learns only scaling vectors, while Tied-LoRA [ 31 ] exploits parameter
sharing and LoRA-FA [ 32 ] freezes one LoRA factor to reduce redundancy or memory consumption.
NOLA [ 15 ] represents LoRA factors using combinations of fixed random
matrices, whereas LoRA-XS [ 16 ] uses SVD-derived bases from pretrained weights and learns only a compact core.
SVFit [ 17 ] further exploits the singular structure of pretrained weights by freezing singular-vector subspaces and optimizing only the most significant singular values.
Nested Low-Rank Adaptation (NoRA) [ 18 ] introduces a nested structure by freezing an outer low-rank representation and optimizing an inner
low-rank adapter.
Beyond factor-level compression, tensorized approaches such as LoRETTA [ 19 ] , TT-LoRA [ 20 ] , LoTR [ 21 ] , and LoRTA [ 22 ] utilize higher-order decompositions to construct
compact adaptation representations.
Kronecker-based methods and folding-based approaches further explore structured update representations [ 33 , 34 ] .
Sharing-based methods, such as MoSA [ 23 ] and RaSA [ 24 ] , reduce adaptation overhead through fine-grained parameter sharing or cross-layer rank sharing.
Unlike these methods that introduce specific structures for individual PEFT formulations, our work proposes a general hierarchical low-rank reparameterization framework that recursively reorganizes the trainable PEFT parameters into compact structures and applies low-rank decomposition level by level. The proposed framework is compatible with various PEFT methods, such as LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of HiLoRR
blocks.zh: 3.1 HILOR概览

blocks.en: HiLoRR is a hierarchical low-rank reparameterization framework for PEFT by reorganizing trainable PEFT parameters into approximately square matrices that are represented via low-rank decompositions, and recursively running the reorganization and decomposition.
blocks.zh: HiLORR是PEFT的分级低级再参数化框架,将可训练的PEFT参数重组为大约方格矩阵,通过低级分解来表示,并递归运行重组和分解.

blocks.en:

Given a PEFT method with a trainable parameter set Θ = { θ 1 , θ 2 , … , θ N } \Theta=\{\theta_{1},\theta_{2},\ldots,\theta_{N}\} , HiLoRR aims to reduce the redundancy inside Θ \Theta through hierarchical low-rank reparameterization.

blocks.en: 3.3 Applying HiLoRR to Different PEFT Methods
blocks.zh: 3.3 将 HILORR 应用到不同的 PEFT 方法

blocks.en: HiLoRR is a general reparameterization framework that can be integrated into various PEFT methods.
blocks.zh: HiLORR是一个一般的再参数化框架,可以融入各种PEFT方法.

blocks.en: HiLoRR for LoRA-based Methods. For PEFT methods derived from LoRA, HiLoRR is applied to the trainable components of the original formulation while preserving their specific design principles.
blocks.zh: HILORR为基于LORA的方法。 对于LORA衍生的PEFT方法,HiLORR适用于原配方的可训练组件,同时保留其具体的设计原理.

blocks.en:
For DoRA, which decomposes the pretrained weight into magnitude and direction components, HiLoRR is applied to the trainable directional parameters.
Specifically, the directional component is replaced by its hierarchical low-rank representation, while the magnitude component is kept in its original form.
The resulting method, referred to as HiDoRA , inherits the magnitude-direction decomposition of DoRA while further reducing the number of trainable parameters through hierarchical
reparameterization.
blocks.zh:
对于将预加载重量分解为量和方向组件的DORA,HiLORR被应用于可加载方向参数.
具体来说,方向部分被其等级低级代表所取代,而规模部分则保持原状.
由此产生的方法称为 HiDoRA , 继承了 DORA 的大小方向分解,同时通过等级进一步减少可训练参数的数量
重修护法.

blocks.en:
Similarly, RaSA introduces rank sharing across different layers to improve parameter efficiency. HiLoRR can be incorporated into RaSA by applying hierarchical reparameterization to the trainable rank-sharing parameters while preserving the original cross-layer sharing mechanism.
The resulting method, denoted as HiRaSA , combines the sharing capability of RaSA with the additional compression capability of HiLoRR.
blocks.zh:
同样,RaSA引入了不同层次的排名共享,以提高参数效率. HiLORR可以通过在保留原有的跨层共享机制的同时,对可训练军衔共享参数进行分级调整,从而融入RASA.
由此产生的方法,即HiRaSA,结合了RaSA的共享能力和HiLORR的额外压缩能力.

blocks.en: HiLoRR for General PEFT Parameterizations. For PEFT methods whose trainable parameters do not follow the LoRA-style factorized formulation, HiLoRR directly operates on the generated trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 通用 PEFT 的 HILORR 参数化. 对于PEFT方法,其可训练参数不遵循LORA式的因子化配体,HILORR直接在生成的可训练参数上运行.

blocks.en:
For example, MoSA represents its trainable parameters as shared parameter vectors. HiLoRR first reorganizes each trainable parameter vector into an approximately square matrix, then applies a low-rank decomposition.
The same hierarchical decomposition process can be recursively applied to the resulting factors.
The resulting method, referred to as HiMoSA , maintains the original parameter sharing mechanism of MoSA while further compressing its trainable parameters through
hierarchical low-rank reparameterization.

同样的等级分解过程可以递归地应用于由此产生的因素.
由此产生的方法称为 HiMoSA, 维持MOSA 的原始参数共享机制,同时通过 :

blocks.en:
These observations motivate a larger learning rate for the reshaped matrices to compensate for their reduced and delayed effective update scale. We therefore treat the learning rate of HiLoRA as a method-specific hyperparameter rather than directly inheriting the default value used by LoRA.
Importantly, the analysis does not imply a universal analytical multiplier: the required compensation depends on the reshaped rank, factor initialization, scaling coefficient, and optimizer.
Our ablation experiments empirically verify that HiLoRA generally achieves its best performance at a higher learning rate than the original PEFT formulation.
blocks.zh:
这些观察促使对重塑的矩阵有更大的学习率,以弥补其缩小和延迟的有效更新规模。 因此,我们把HiLORA的学习率视为一种方法特有的超参数,而不是直接继承LORA使用的默认值.
重要的是,分析并不意味着通用分析乘数:所需补偿取决于重塑的等级、要素初始化、规模系数和优化因素。
我们的减速实验实证地证实,HILORA一般在比最初的PEFT配方更高的学习速率上达到最佳成绩.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate HiLoRR as a general hierarchical low-rank reparameterization
framework on two model families and two reasoning tasks. Our experiments
are organized around three questions: (i) can HiLoRA/HiDoRA reduce trainable
parameters while preserving the performance of LoRA/DoRA on reasoning tasks?
(ii) can the proposed reparameterization be extended to different PEFT
formulations? and (iii) how do different hierarchical configurations
affect the compression-performance trade-off?

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use two open base (non-instruct) models, i.e., LLaMA-3.1-8B [ 25 ] and Qwen2.5-7B [ 26 ] .
Base models are chosen so that the reported gains reflect what the PEFT method itself learns, rather than instruction-tuning already baked into the backbone.
The two models differ in architecture (grouped-query attention configuration, intermediate width), allowing us to test cross-architecture generalization.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results: Commonsense Reasoning

blocks.en:
We evaluate HiLoRA and HiDoRA on the commonsense reasoning tasks.
Table 1 presents results on LLaMA-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B under low- and
high-parameter settings.
In each setting, the highest Avg. and W-Avg. scores are obtained by either HiLoRA or HiDoRA. In the low-parameter setting , both methods achieve higher Avg. and W-Avg. scores than all baselines reported in Table 1 on both backbones, while using approximately 10–13 % \% of the trainable parameters of the corresponding LoRA-r16 baseline.
These results show that substantial parameter compression can maintain strong average accuracy across the eight benchmarks, while directly reducing the LoRA rank to decrease the number of trainable parameters can lead to degraded task performance. In the high-parameter setting , HiLoRA and HiDoRA outperform LoRA and DoRA on both aggregate metrics with comparable numbers of trainable parameters. This indicates that hierarchical reparameterization can also improve performance at a similar parameter budget. In terms of training memory , HiLoRA and HiDoRA have peak allocated GPU memory comparable to LoRA and DoRA and substantially lower than the reported NoRA and SVFit configurations.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 结论和讨论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced HiLoRR, a hierarchical low-rank reparameterization framework for further compressing the trainable parameters introduced by parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods.
HiLoRR reorganizes the parameters generated by an existing PEFT
method into approximately square matrices and represents them using
additional low-rank factorizations. This operation can be applied
recursively, forming a hierarchical parameterization.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了HiLORR,这是一种分级低等级的再参数化框架,用于进一步压缩参数效率微调方法引入的可列车参数.
HILORR 重组现有 PEFT 生成的参数
方法进入大约平方矩阵,并使用
额外的低级因素化。 此操作可以应用
递归,形成分级参数化.

blocks.en:
Our main finding is that the trainable parameters introduced by existing PEFT methods contain substantial internal redundancy. When applied to LoRA, HiLoRA retains the original outer adaptation rank while using only about one tenth of the trainable parameters of the full-size LoRA adapter.
Despite this substantial reduction, the compressed models maintain performance close to, and in some settings comparable with, the original methods across different model architectures and reasoning tasks.
These results demonstrate that effective downstream adaptation can be achieved with a considerably more compact parameterization, making HiLoRR particularly suitable when adapter storage, optimizer states, or task-specific parameter budgets are constrained.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要发现是,现有的PEFT方法引入的可训练参数包含大量的内部冗余. 当应用到LORA时,HiLORA保留了原来的外部适应等级,同时仅使用全尺寸LORA适配器的可训练参数的约十分之一.
尽管如此大幅度的削减,压缩模型仍然保持了与不同模型架构和推理任务的原始方法相近的性能,在某些环境下与之相当.
这些结果表明,如果参数化程度明显提高,就能实现下游有效的适应,使HiLORR在适配器存储、优化器状态或特定任务参数预算受到限制时特别适合。

blocks.en: Moreover, applying the same reparameterization principle to LoRA, DoRA, MoSA, and RaSA suggests that our method provides a general compression framework rather than a method-specific modification.
blocks.zh: 此外,对LORA,DORA,MOSA,和RASA适用同样的再平衡原则表明,我们的方法提供了一个总的压缩框架,而不是一个方法特有的修改.

blocks.en: The additional multiplicative structure changes the optimization behavior and makes performance more sensitive to the learning rate, factor initialization, hierarchical rank, and reshaping strategy. Future work may explore adaptive rank allocation, architecture-aware reshaping, and more efficient optimization strategies, as well as extending HiLoRR to broader model families, modalities, and downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 附加的多功能结构会改变优化行为,使性能对学习率,要素初始化,等级分级,重塑策略更加敏感. 今后的工作可能探讨适应性等级分配、建筑意识的调整和更有效的优化战略,以及将HILORR扩大到更广泛的示范家庭、模式和下游任务。

blocks.en: A.2 HiLoRR Configurations
blocks.zh: A.2 HILOR 配置

blocks.en:
HiLoRR can be configured with different reparameterization strategies
according to the target PEFT parameters. We consider three variants:
Single-side HiLoRR, Dual-side HiLoRR, and Multi-level HiLoRR.

HILORR 配置时可以使用不同的重新参数化策略

单侧HILOR,双侧HILOR,和多层HILOR.

blocks.en:
Single-side HiLoRR. Single-side HiLoRR applies hierarchical low-rank reparameterization to
only one trainable component while keeping the remaining parameters
unchanged. For LoRA-based methods, it only compresses one factor (e.g., B B ) and preserves the original update formulation.

blocks.en:
Dual-side HiLoRR. Dual-side HiLoRR extends Single-side HiLoRR by simultaneously
reparameterizing both trainable factors. For LoRA-based methods, both A A and B B are compressed through HiLoRR, providing stronger parameter
reduction while maintaining the original adaptation mechanism.

blocks.en:
Multi-level HiLoRR. Multi-level HiLoRR recursively applies low-rank reparameterization to
the resulting factors. By increasing the hierarchy depth, HiLoRR
achieves additional parameter compression and provides a flexible
trade-off between compression ratio and adaptation capacity.
